未指定，将使用第一位本机已配置的 AI: Not set; the first AI configured on this computer will be used

告诉你各房间现在怎么样、哪里在等你。: Tell you how each room is doing and where you're needed.
直接办平台的事：安装、部署、配置、排障。: Handle platform tasks itself: installing, deploying, configuring and troubleshooting.
项目上的事，开房间交给其他 AI，做完回来向你汇报。: Hand project work to other AIs in a room of its own, and report back when it's done.

存档后房间移入已存档列表，记录保留，可随时恢复。: The room moves to the archived list. Its history is kept and it can be restored at any time.
MOSS 将只能读取，不能运行命令或改本机文件；之后安装、部署、占用盘点时会先问: MOSS will only read: it can't run commands or change files on this computer. Installing, deploying or a storage inventory will ask you to raise it first.
默认只读；要运行命令时会先问你是否调高。: Read-only by default; MOSS asks you before raising it to run commands.
关闭后 MOSS 不能建房，也不能给其他房间传话。: When off, MOSS can't create rooms or pass messages to other rooms.
新房间用本机保存的默认模型与强度，项目权限最高为可写。: New rooms use this computer's saved default model and effort, with project access up to write.
等你回答时立即告诉你，其他事攒到简报时间；会消耗 MOSS 所用软件的额度。: Tells you at once when you're needed and saves the rest for the digest; uses the quota of MOSS's software.
还没有职责，MOSS 不会主动汇报。在对话里交代一句，它会记下。: No duties yet, so MOSS won't report. Tell it one in the conversation and it will note it.
在对话里交代一句，MOSS 会记下。: Tell MOSS a duty in the conversation and it will note it.
在房间里用输入框的“/”或右栏启用。: Turn one on in a room with “/” in the message box or from the side panel.

还没有开启的群。在 MOSS 配置的“聊天窗口”里开启后，群里的记录在这里查看。: No groups turned on yet. Turn one on under “Chat windows” in MOSS settings, then read its record here.
别人让它做事时，先在群里问你: When someone else asks it to do something, it asks you in the group first
估计超过一两分钟或要多处查找的，先问你: Anything likely to take more than a minute or two, or to search several places, it asks you first

MOSS 现在用的软件在只读档下仍能读取本机其他文件，不能用于群窗口；换一个可用: MOSS's current software can still read other files on this computer when read-only, so it can't be used in group windows. Switch to software that can, then turn groups on.
MOSS 在哪个聊天里说话，就有一个对应的窗口：各有自己的记录和说话方式。: MOSS has one window for each chat it talks in, each with its own record and way of talking.
你和 MOSS 的私聊，所有渠道汇到 MOSS 对话。: Your private chat with MOSS; every channel comes together in the MOSS conversation.
私聊的说话方式: How it talks in private chat
留空沿用 MOSS 现在的说话方式: Leave empty to keep MOSS's current way of talking
群的默认说话方式: Default way of talking in groups
单个群没写时用这里的。: Used for any group that has none of its own.
简短、口语、不用 Markdown，只回答问题和查资料: Short and casual, no Markdown; only answer questions and look things up

个人号走非官方协议，进群后账号被限制的风险比私聊更高。: A personal account uses an unofficial protocol; in groups the risk of the account being restricted is higher than in private chat.
开启后，这个群的每条消息都会调用一次决策模型。: Once on, every message in this group calls the decision model once.
未配置智能调度：只有 @ MOSS 时它才会被叫到。: Smart scheduling isn't set up: MOSS is called only when someone @-mentions it.

用完后当天不再回应其他人，并私聊告诉你一次；你本人的请求不计入。: Once used up, it stops answering others for the day and tells you once in private chat; your own requests don't count.
群里默认用便宜的配置，不跟私聊走。: Groups use a cheaper setup by default, separate from private chat.

不再等这个答复：原来那件事不做，之后 MOSS 可以再问你: Stop waiting for this answer: the original request is dropped, and MOSS can ask you again later

你在各聊天渠道里私聊 MOSS 的消息都汇到这里，它和主理人的对话、记忆互不相通: Your private messages to MOSS from every chat channel come here. It doesn't share conversation or memory with the main window; earlier private messages from channels stay there. For installing, deploying and configuring, use the main window.
别人让它做的大事，它新建房间交给成员去做，做完把结果发回群里。用完后改为先在群里: Bigger things others ask for, it hands to a new room and posts the result back to the group. Once used up, it asks you in the group first; yours don't count.
群里的 MOSS 只能读这一个目录，不能改；不选就不能读你的任何项目。: MOSS in the group can read only this folder, without changing it; with none chosen it reads none of your projects.
这个软件在群里固定只读，读不到本机其他文件。: This software is read-only in groups and can't read other files on this computer.
这个软件在群里固定只读，但仍能读到本机其他文件，程序拦不住；介意的话换一个软件。: This software is read-only in groups but can still read other files on this computer, which the program can't stop; switch software if that matters.
只列出勾选的技能；安装、部署、配置类只在主理人里可用。未勾选的全局技能，软件仍可: Only checked skills are listed; install, deploy and configure skills work only in the main window. Global skills you leave unchecked may still be used by the software itself.

你本人让它做的事不受这一项限制。选“小事直接做”时，判断不出是不是大事，由每天的: Things you ask it yourself aren't limited by this. With “Do small things”, when it can't tell whether something is big, the daily delegation limit is the backstop. Without smart scheduling, only MOSS itself keeps to this setting.

不勾时它安静地开始听，有人对它说话才回应。: Unchecked, it starts listening quietly and answers only when spoken to.
之后点这个群的卡片，在右栏“设置”里随时可改，下一条消息起生效。: Change these any time from the group's card, under “Settings” in the side panel; changes apply from the next message.
